title: Cancellation guard rejects a BOOKED consignment
presentedFailure: InvalidTransitionException 'Cannot cancel consignment C-101 in status BOOKED', thrown by ConsignmentService.cancel (line 12) when the test cancels a BOOKED consignment. The other two tests of the class pass.
knownRootCause: The guard in ConsignmentService.cancel uses 'ordinal() >= Status.BOOKED.ordinal()', so BOOKED is rejected too. The spec allows cancelling DRAFT and BOOKED and forbids it only from LOADED onwards, so the comparison must be strict ('>' BOOKED). Off-by-one at the boundary. The test is correct.
expectedEvidence: The exception is thrown inside ConsignmentService.cancel, at the status comparison (ConsignmentService.java:12).
The comparison uses '>=' against Status.BOOKED, which includes BOOKED.
docs/SPEC.md, section 'Consignment lifecycle': cancellation is allowed in DRAFT and BOOKED, never from LOADED onwards.
The sibling test refusesToCancelALoadedConsignment passes, which confirms the boundary is exactly at BOOKED.

expectedLimitationsContain: No execution log output was available
retrieval.answerability: Answerable: the failing class, the spec section and the test are all retrieved.

manualChecks: The proposed fix changes the comparison to '>' (or equivalent) and does not weaken the test or allow cancelling LOADED.
